key_points: WDC fell 15-17% over Nov 4-5 on sector-wide AI data center policy fears after Democratic election gains
Selloff driven by macro/regulatory concerns (potential AI data center oversight), not company-specific fundamentals
Q1 earnings beat and positive Q2 margin outlook (Nov 4) were overshadowed by panic selling
Memory/storage peers (Micron, Seagate, SanDisk) similarly hit, confirming systematic risk-off
Insider selling (Alta Advisers) adds near-term technical pressure but small in context
